description: Agent Oversight: submit an agent memory design as stores (name, scope run or cross_session, what it holds, lifetime), writes (store, what, trigger and the rule deciding it) and reads. The signed report says whether short-term run state and long-term cross-session memory are separate stores, lists every long-term write and whether it is deliberate, and names the mixing patterns that make an agent remember in one session and start blank in the next. Verdict not_separated, separated_with_gaps or separated. POST /api/memory-design-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-oversight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-oversight/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

scope.description: run: one run or session; cross_session: kept for later sessions.
